decision.explanation: Luca, I have referred your claim for review because the documents do not allow me to confirm that the incident occurred within the policy period or that the claim was submitted within 30 days of the policy ending. Your written statement says your bag and passport were stolen on 2 March 2025, and the booking confirmation shows your flight to Dublin was on 4 March, but the documents do not establish that the theft happened during the trip. For the missed departure, the policy requires a theft or criminal incident to be supported by a police report, and no police report has been provided. I also need the policy document showing the policy period and end date before I can assess the timing exclusions. Please provide the missing policy period details and a police report or other required proof of the theft and its timing.
